buckets.name: Solar
buckets.scope: All PV and solar-thermal electricity generation, from cell technologies to deployment formats, plus PV circularity
variations: utility-scale crystalline silicon PV (TOPCon, HJT, back-contact) incl. trackers & BOS hardware
emerging PV materials (organic, quantum dot, kesterite)
building- and vehicle-integrated PV incl. solar windows/transparent PV
concentrated solar power (power tower, parabolic trough, linear Fresnel, dish)

buckets.name: Wind
buckets.scope: All wind electricity generation formats plus wind-asset life extension and circularity
variations: fixed-bottom offshore wind (incl. foundations & installation tech)
floating offshore wind platforms & mooring systems
wind repowering, blade recycling & life extension

buckets.name: Geothermal
buckets.scope: Earth-heat power generation and direct use, conventional through next-gen (subsurface pressure storage lives in the LDES bucket)
variations: conventional hydrothermal (dry steam, flash, binary ORC)
advanced drilling & exploration tech (millimeter-wave, plasma, AI prospecting)

buckets.name: Hydro & Marine Energy
buckets.scope: Water-driven generation from rivers, tides, waves, and ocean gradients (pumped storage hydro lives in the LDES bucket)
variations: wave energy converters (point absorber, oscillating water column, attenuator, overtopping)

buckets.name: Nuclear Fission
buckets.scope: Fission reactors of every size plus the fuel cycle and waste/recycling supply chain
variations: large light-water reactors (GW-scale new build & restarts)
molten salt reactors incl. thorium fuel cycles
fuel cycle & enrichment (HALEU, TRISO) plus waste disposal & recycling

buckets.name: Fusion
buckets.scope: All fusion confinement approaches plus the fusion-specific supply chain
variations: fusion supply chain (HTS magnets, lasers, targets, blankets, tritium handling)

buckets.name: Electrochemical Storage
buckets.scope: Stationary grid-connected battery storage across every chemistry (EV traction batteries out of scope; they belong to transport)
variations: zinc-based non-flow batteries (zinc-bromine static, zinc-air, zinc-manganese)
solid-state & advanced lithium for stationary use

buckets.name: Thermal & Mechanical Long-Duration Storage
buckets.scope: Non-electrochemical storage: heat, gravity, compressed gas, water, flywheels, and hydrogen power-to-power
variations: high-temperature thermal batteries (molten salt, bricks, sand, carbon blocks + TPV)
gravity storage (towers, mine shafts, rail, cranes)
compressed air energy storage (adiabatic & underground caverns)
pumped storage hydro (conventional, closed-loop, high-density fluid, subsea)
hydrogen power-to-power LDES (electrolyzer + cavern/tank + fuel cell or turbine)

buckets.name: Grid & Transmission Hardware
buckets.scope: Hardware that moves, converts, and stabilizes grid electricity, including grid-enhancing technologies
variations: dynamic line rating & transmission monitoring sensors
power-flow control devices (FACTS, SSSC, modular power flow controllers)
